title: Universal Invention Engine — Overview and definition
t: Universal Invention Engine — Overview and definition
description: Takes a problem, discovers candidate solutions, and drafts build plans. (Proposed capability.)
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Takes a problem, discovers candidate solutions, and drafts build plans. (Proposed capability.) A universal invention engine would take a problem statement, search solution principles across domains, draft candidate designs, and output build plans with verification steps. Today this exists only as research prototypes combining LLMs, knowledge graphs, and generative design. Status: speculative. Capability status: PROPOSED. This database describes a proposed capability, not a completed product. Status taxonomy used throughout: speculative (no demonstrated path), simulated (works in simulation only), experimentally-demonstrated (lab demo exists), independently-verified (reproduced by a third party). Generating a design cannot make impossible physics possible; every record states which status its claims carry. Capability status for this tool: speculative.

title: Universal Invention Engine — Teaching-ladder exercise
description: Takes a problem, discovers candidate solutions, and drafts build plans. (Proposed capability.)
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Teaching ladder for Universal Invention Engine, simple to complex. Rank 1: name the tool's single core action (Problem decomposition into solvable sub-problems). Rank 3: run it once on a tiny input and check the output. Rank 5: combine two capabilities: Problem decomposition into solvable sub-problems and Cross-domain solution-principle retrieval. Rank 7: chain its output into a neighboring tool (Impossible-Design Explorer) with a verification checkpoint. Rank 9+: automate the full workflow and teach it to someone else. Capability status for this tool: speculative.
